+title: Every AVK control is an EditorKit component or an EditorKit wrapper
+---
+Request from TestudoApp (relayed by testudoapp-9a, 2026-11-25). User rule for all kits: "I also want us using our EK components, even as just 'wrappers' -- so that we always get theme support. When I see a square ring or other bullshit that pisses me off." EditorKit adds the wrappers that are missing and a source-scan test helper.
+
+## What
+
+- [ ] List each raw SwiftUI or AppKit control in `Sources/AgentViewKit`, `Sources/AgentViewKitStyle` and `Sources/AgentViewKitDemoSupport`: `Button(`, `Toggle(`, `TextField(`, `SecureField(`, `Picker(`, `Menu(`, `Link(`, `Slider(`, `Stepper(`, `DatePicker(`, `ProgressView(`, `DisclosureGroup(`, `TextEditor(`, `NSButton`, `NSTextField`, `NSPopUpButton`, `NSSegmentedControl`. A first scan found about 24 uses in about 19 files, for example `Elicitation/ElicitationFieldViews.swift` (6), `Activity/ActivityIndicator.swift`, `Items/JSONDisclosure.swift`, `Content/Blocks/AudioPlayerView.swift`, `Code/BlockHeader.swift`, `Input/DefaultPromptAccessory.swift`, `Thread/SideQuestionCard.swift`. Add the list to `Docs/decisions/focus-audit.md` (from ^b0a65bh): place, raw control, EditorKit component or wrapper.
+- [ ] Change each raw control to the EditorKit component where one exists on EditorKit main now (for example `EditorButton`).
+- [ ] For a control with no EditorKit component yet, ask the EditorKit session for the wrapper, and change it when the wrapper is on EditorKit main.
+- [ ] Add the scan test with the EditorKit source-scan test helper when it is on main. Until then, a local scan in the same test file.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] No file under `Sources/` uses a raw SwiftUI or AppKit control from the list above. Each control is an EditorKit component or wrapper.
+- [ ] The scan test fails when a raw control is added.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] New `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Style/EditorKitControlSourceTests.swift`: scans the files under `Sources/` for the raw controls above and fails on each one (it uses the EditorKit helper when it exists).
+- [ ] The existing tests of each changed view still pass. `HOME=$(mktemp -d) swift test` passes with 0 failures and 0 warnings. Gallery images for review (light and dark) after the change.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+- Start after the AVK scroll profile run ends (one screen user at a time).
+- When done: push, and send the sha to testudoapp-9a.
\ No newline at end of file
